biz_sticker_language_success_hero_subtit: Zikomo chifukwa chopempha mafayilo a zitikiti za 'Bitcoin Imalandiridwa Pano' mu chilankhulo chanu.
biz_sticker_language_success_timeline_c1: Tikupanga ndi kutulutsa mafayilo anu a zitikiti mu sabata 3–4. Akakhala okonzeka, mukhoza kutsitsa ndi kuwasindikiza mwaulere kuchokera tsamba lathu la mafayilo a zitikiti.
biz_sticker_language_success_timeline_c2: Timatulutsa zitikiti m'magulu — chilankhulo chanu chikhoza kutenga sabata yochepa kuti chitulutsidwe. Zikomo chifukwa cha kupirira kwanu.
